attributes.title: 2027 Southwest Dental Conference
attributes.summary:
The 2027 Southwest Dental Conference is hosted by the Dallas County Dental Society in Dallas. The official registration page lists on-site registration hours for Thursday August 19, Friday August 20 and Saturday August 21, with 2027 deadlines, so we show August 19 to 21, 2027; confirm the dates with the organizer.

All courses are ticketed. Registration opens in March 2027; a $50 late fee applies after July 12, 2027, and the refund deadline is July 23, 2027. The Hilton Anatole Dallas is the headquarters hotel. DCDS is an ADA CERP Recognized Provider and grants one credit per hour unless noted. Fees and the course brochure are not published yet.
